endpoints.name: UpdateFactoryUnit

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates factory unit name. Checks for duplicate excluding current ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. ID > 0. Unit exists. Unit name non-empty. No duplicate (excluding current ID).
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ID > 0. Unit exists. Unit name provided. Duplicate check (excluding current ID).
business_logic.side_effects: Unit updated with modified_by and modified_date.
business_logic.state_changes: sets existing.units, existing.modified_date, existing.modified_by and saves changes
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Valid Factory Unit ID is required.
Factory Unit name must be provided for update.

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check per ID reduces risk.

endpoints.detailed_description: Update existing factory unit name. error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid Factory Unit ID is required. [when id <= 0]; Factory Unit name must be provided for update. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Units)]
